78114.subject: Your login change is moving to 10 September
78114.body:
The switch to Passkey login
now happens on 10 September. Keep logging in as usual until
then.

*****************************************************************
AN UPDATE ON YOUR LOGIN
CHANGE.
*****************************************************************

Hi
Novosadov Oleh,

As previously
communicated, we're updating how you log in to Socios.com, moving
to Passkey and retiring phone number and SMS login. These changes
will now apply from 10 September 2026 onwards, instead of 27
August.

Nothing changes before
10 September

Keep logging in exactly
as you do today through phone number login, so there's nothing
you need to do differently for now. If you already use a Passkey,
you're all set.

What's
happening on 10 September

From that date, your
Passkey becomes the way you log in, and your email becomes how
you keep your account secure and how we reach you. Phone number
login stays available as a backup for a while longer, then
retires from the app for good.

IMPORTANT: 2 steps to
secure your account and wallet

1. Verify
your email address

Your email is how you
get back into your account if you ever lose access to your
Passkey, and how we send you security updates. Open Account
Management in the app and make sure your email is verified, so
you don't risk losing access.

2.
Generate and save your Recovery
Kit

If you lose your
Passkey, your Recovery Kit is the only way to restore access to
your Socios.com Wallet and assets. If you haven't created one
yet, go to Account Management > Recovery Kit in the app, generate
your kit, and store it somewhere
safe.

Socios.com cannot
restore your wallet or assets if both your Passkey and Recovery
Kit are lost.

You can
review the updated terms here
